changelog: 🌿 Phase 9 Upgrade: Interactive Git Commit Graph DAG Engine & Commit Inspector in Rust.
⚡ Native DAG Layout Engine: Microsecond topological lane allocation (`agy_ide_bridge_rs`) rendering multi-branch metro-style Bezier graphs in Android Compose.
🔎 Deep Commit Inspector: Instant commit details (`/api/git/commit/details`), changed files numstat, shortstats, and single-file diff viewer (`/api/git/commit/diff`).
